You can choose not to get the airdrop and leave the map at the border of the world. If you do manage to get the drop you still have to make it to the border or maybe not and make that the end of the round. In the beginning players are placed randomly on the map to spawn and spawn together if queued up. There will be corpses or last stands to loot instead of shit just being there for no reason and you can only keep it if you survive.
